summary: Orbit Academy — Base Commander is a comprehensive educational simulation game inspired by NASA data that combines space exploration, rocket launching, cargo management, and 3D base construction. The game features a rocket launch arcade simulation, 3D base-building scenarios, 15 different exploration destinations ranging from the Moon to Pluto, and 6 educational mini-games such as Asteroid Escape and a Planetary Knowledge Quiz. Players design their cargo within limits of a 650 kg mass and 150 credit budget by optimizing equipment such as solar panels, batteries, life support systems, greenhouses, science laboratories, and protective walls. In a 3D environment compatible with mobile and computer controls, players ensure a safe landing by utilizing the rocket's braking engine, followed by simulating the survival of the base over a 24-hour cycle featuring 14 hours of light and 10 hours of shadow. Additionally, the application includes a NASA Data Center offering interactive graphics and tables that compare the diameter, mass, gravity, escape velocity, solar irradiance, and atmospheric properties of the Moon, Mars, and Earth using NASA/JPL NSSDC data, alongside an experiment log supporting a "predict and test" approach.
details:
• What do you do? For the Moon, Mars, or 15 different planets/moons, you select cargo within budget and weight limits (650 kg / 150 credits), soft-land your spacecraft (under 3.5 m/s), and build your 3D base to keep your crew alive for 24 hours.
  • What else is included? It features a rocket launch arcade mode, an advanced mission design lab, 6 mini-games, and a JSON reporting system that logs experiment results.
  • Architecture: It runs inside a single HTML file using zero external files or libraries (built with pure JS, Canvas 3D, and Web Audio sound effects), and is compatible with both desktop and mobile devices.
